units.source_text: 看样子无法通过她刚才扒拉开草丛登上来的那片山白竹了，所以只好沿着大田边向有水流声的方向走下去。

en.t: It seemed impossible to pass through the mountain bamboo where she had just pushed aside the grass and climbed up, so they had no choice but to go down along the edge of the large field toward the sound of running water.

units.source_text: 河岸陡削，形成了一道悬崖绝壁。

en.t: The riverbank dropped steeply, forming a sheer cliff.

units.source_text: 从栗树上传来了孩子的声音。

en.t: Children's voices came from up in the chestnut tree.

units.source_text: 有几颗毛栗落在他们脚底下的草丛里。

en.t: Several prickly chestnut burrs had fallen into the grass at their feet.

units.source_text: 驹子用木屐踩碎外壳，把栗子剥出来。

en.t: Komako crushed the shells with her wooden clogs and peeled out the chestnuts.
